positive_change.result: Chaque mardi, une cheffe prépare 100 repas à partir d'ingrédients récupérés dans une banque alimentaire.
positive_change.beneficiaries: Les personnes en situation de précarité qui bénéficient de ces repas.

fact_checks.sentence: Depuis plusieurs années, Maddy Goldberg, cheffe basée à Toronto, cuisine tous les mardis pour 100 personnes en difficulté en utilisant uniquement les aliments qu'elle récupère dans une banque alimentaire locale.
source_passages: That’s because every Tuesday for years, Goldberg has been donating her time to prepare banquets for 100 people in need out of what she finds at the local food bank.

How does that work?” Goldberg would eventually leave the restaurant world in favor of private cheffing so as to make sure she had time and room to volunteer, which she began to do at Fort York Food Bank in Toronto.

fact_checks.sentence: Elle élabore des plats variés, parfois raffinés, à partir des ingrédients disponibles, évitant ainsi le gaspillage.
source_passages: Far from just making spaghetti and meat sauce, or canned this with a side of canned that, Goldberg uses an arsenal of different techniques and flavors to make restaurant-quality dishes, like a lentil fritter spiced with caramelized onion, cinnamon, and curry powder.
She now boasts 180,000 followers of her work on Instagram, where her food bank banquet prep videos go back to January of 2025, regularly make their mouths—and their hearts—drool.
